children: Shares of HDFC Bank traded largely flat in the mid-session on Thursday, after opening lower against the previous close. The stock traded at ₹731.20 at 12.10 pm, after moving between ₹722.70 and ₹734.85 during the session. It opened at ₹725, compared with the previous close of ₹737.25.
Buy quantity stood at 51.09 per cent at 13,38,744, while sell quantity was 48.91 per cent at 12,81,551.

title: HDFC Bank shares in focus: Stock down over 26% YTD, Q2 results due October 17
